title: Lamb Kebab Dim Sum
description: A fusion of Asian and Middle Eastern flavors in a crispy dim sum wrapper.

ingredients.name: Kicked
ingredients.notes: Assuming 'kicked' meant kick of flavors, this ingredient is likely a spice blend. Ignoring for this recipe.

ingredients.name: Dim sum wrappers
ingredients.notes: Typically found in the frozen food section

ingredients.name: Fluffy
ingredients.notes: Assuming 'fluffy' meant fluffy rice. Ignoring for this recipe.

ingredients.name: Lamb
ingredients.notes: You already have lamb. Removing redundancy.

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil
ingredients.notes: For brushing the dim sum wrappers

instructions: Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F.
Cut the lamb into small pieces and mix with salt, black pepper, and any other desired spices.
Place a few pieces of lamb onto the center of a dim sum wrapper.
Brush the edges of the wrapper with oil and fold the wrapper into a triangle.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and lamb.
Fry the dim sum for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Serve hot with green onions as garnish.
Optional: Serve with a side of sweet chili sauce for dipping.
